cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "{faction} have clocked our {ore} numbers. They'll want a word, and I doubt they'll ask nicely."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Their opinion of us moves on favours, gifts and supply contracts. Do those well and it softens. Ignore them and it sours."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "That's the lot. We have a footing, a supplier, a rival who knows our name and at least one friend. Not a bad quarter."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "The books agree with him, which is rarer than it sounds."

cards.speaker: Owen
cards.text: "The veins don't care either way. Keep them fed and they'll keep you."
